products.title: Founder Access Continuity Organizer
products.audience: Solo founders and one-person businesses who are the single point of failure for everything the business needs.
products.problem: If a solo founder is unreachable, nobody else knows what the business runs on or how to restore access, and writing the passwords on paper is the unsafe answer.
products.price_rationale: Cycle 99 founder directive (2026-10-19): B12-003 publication authorized; final price set by the directive's own rule - the highest price that passes every mandatory gate. USD 8.00 is the maximum price economics.market_realism_check permits for an 8-page guide (min($1.00 x 8 pages, $15.00 short-book ceiling) = $8.00); the previously recorded USD 19.00 FAILED that mandatory gate. It is priced below the direct business-continuity comparable cluster ($20.22-$79.00). Basis FOUNDER_DECISION_BELOW_COMPARABLE. Evidence: data/evidence/b12_003_competitors.json, this gate file.
products.outcome: A filled inventory of what exists, where it lives and who may touch it, a three-envelope custody method, and an annual drill that keeps the plan true without writing a password.
products.competition_level: MEDIUM-HIGH: 14 real paid comparables $6.75-$79 (business-continuity cluster $37-$79; closest-shape packs $6.75-$20.22) (data/evidence/b12_003_competitors.json)
